translations.en: You expected her to be more persistent,
but @7rCarmine@0r seems to back down surprisingly easily.
Still, you are certain
that she sincerely needs your help.
Sorry to bother you when you've only just arrived,
but could you hear me out?
You're trying to find a way to save this city too, right?
You can work with @7rBeatrix@0r and still help me out.
That's how an adventurer gets by, isn't it?
Even I don't think @7rBeatrix@0r is to blame for everything.
But there's something about that woman I just can't trust.
Come on, @7rCyrus@0r. You think so too, don't you?
H-hey...
Y-yeah. I do.
@7rCarmine@0r still seems to treat @7rCyrus@0r as a friend,
even though she knows he was planning
to escape the city on his own.
@7rCyrus@0r must feel uncomfortable after betraying her,
but this is @7rCarmine's@0r way of showing kindness.
If he stays and helps from now on, things should work out.
Anyway, we still don't know what caused that strange light and rumbling.
After such a huge, ominous flash and roar,
nothing seems to have changed.
That's not true.
The city's been acting strange,
and the monsters are much more active.
Above all, new ruins have been discovered in the city...
Right. Did you hear they found a new district after that incident?
I get the feeling @7rBeatrix@0r knew
that district existed long before this happened.
That's why I don't trust her completely.
Our goal's the same, but I'll be doing my own investigating.
I hope you understand.
As for the job this time, I want to investigate the new district.
Every place we've found connected to @7rChu Lu Gah@0r
has been a research facility. We haven't found anywhere he lived.
That means @7rChu Lu Gah's@0r house must be out there somewhere.
I want to find it, somehow, and uncover @7rChu Lu Gah's@0r
true nature.
Once we know what @7rChu Lu Gah@0r was really like,
I think we'll find a lead to solving this whole mystery.
I'd like you to come along as my bodyguards.
What do you say? Will you do it?
You received a @3rHealing Ring@0r and a @3rThief's Toolkit@0r.
You found it for me?
Thank you sooo much!
Hurry, let me see!
You hand your delighted, beaming companion
@7rTanya@0r the @3rAncient Coin@0r.
Wow! I've never seen money like this before!
It must be really old.
Thank you so much!
I'm so happy!
Here, you can have these as a thank-you.
From @7rTanya@0r, you received a @3rMagic Coin@0r,
a @3rHealing Ring@0r, a @3rThief's Toolkit@0r, and @3r10,000 G@0r.
The coin's surface is covered in hieroglyphs,
with a red gemstone set in its center.
I found that a long time ago,
when I secretly went exploring in the ruins.
When I gave it to Grandma, she said it was enchanted
and that @7rTanya@0r should treasure it.
But I thought it might make a good good-luck charm,
so I want you to have it.
I'm not like @7rBeatrix@0r or @7rCarmine@0r.
I don't understand all that complicated stuff, so whenever you go adventuring,
I always pray that you'll come back safe.
So please do your best!
Well, I'm going to take this money to Grandma.
See you!
You received @3r10,000 G@0r.
I can't wait to see how happy Grandma will be.
She worked so hard to raise me,
and I love seeing her happy.
So please try your best to find them!
I'm counting on you!
Huh? Have you decided
to look for that old money for me?
I'd be really happy if you did...
I'll give you my enchanted treasure as a thank-you,

context: Carmine explains her mistrust of Beatrix and seeks escort; Tanya later receives coins and offers her enchanted keepsake.
decisions: Control tokens remain on their source rows and in their original sequence. Genuine sentence continuations retain row boundaries; other omitted subjects are restored from scene context. Unknown historical warrior gender stays neutral. Item names follow the shared glossary; established imported prose and provenance remain intact.
